source.source_name: GitHub REST workflow runs: statuses and conclusions
source.purpose: Official workflow-run status enumeration and list endpoint behavior for fail-closed CI health reporting
source.cost_quota: free public official documentation; no API credit
source.reliability_limits: Documents API statuses, not a proof of repo CI success; branch-specific current run and main read-back require live verification.

learning.title: Newest pending CI run cannot be hidden by older success
learning.claim: GitHub workflow-run list responses include status values such as queued, in_progress, requested, waiting and pending. A newest run that is not completed cannot be replaced by an older successful run when reporting current workflow health; the newest run's pending state must remain visible and the result must not be marked all-green.
learning.decision: CI_NEWEST_PENDING_STATUS_GATE: Use the newest run per workflow even when it is queued or in progress; never fall back to an older success. Report pending and failed workflows separately, and never call CI all-green until the current run completes. A complete list scan can still contain unfinished runs.
